La cuarta receta de Banchan coreano es otro clásico: dubu-jorim, tofu en salsa de soja al estilo coreano. La versión más común suele llevar gochugaru, copos de chile coreano, pero también se puede preparar sin picante. Lo de cubrir el tofu con maicena antes de dorarlo no se hace en todas las casas: hay quien lo hace y hay quien no.  Pero personalmente, me gusta mucho más así, porque le da una textura más crujiente y un poco más masticable. Pero si te da pereza, puedes saltarte ese paso sin problema :) [Ingredientes] *cda=Cucharada(Tbs, 15ml) *cdta=Cucharadita(Tsp, 5ml) 300 g de tofu firme 2 cdas de almidón de maíz 2 cdas de aceite vegetal 1,5 cda de salsa de soja 1 cda de salsa de ostras 1 cda de miel 4 g de ajo picado 2cdas de agua 15 g de cebolleta, picada(o puerro, cebollino, cebollín) #두부조림 #dubujorim #comidacoreana #koreanfood #recetafacil

As night falls, dozens of glowing lanterns light up both the indoor and outdoor spaces, while floating lanterns suspended from the ceiling create the magical feeling of stepping into a fairy tale. ⠀ The cafe also offers a wide selection of freshly baked pastries and drinks, making it a perfect place to relax. A spoonful of chili oil and seafood make everything hotter and better.🔥 Shrimp heads, soft tofu, crab, octopus, and juicy shrimp simmer into a rich, spicy broth that’s guaranteed to bring you back to life❤️‍🔥 Would you try this after a night out?🍜✨ 📍 Tag your late-night buddy & save this recipe for your next rough morning ✨ Hailey’s Hangover Seafood Tofu Ramen 📝 Ingredients * 2–3 tbsp chili oil * 2 eggs * 1 green onion, chopped * 2–3 cloves garlic, sliced * 1 pack Shin Ramyun (soup base + veggie packet) * 2 cups water * 3–5 large shrimp (heads separated) * 1 small crab * Baby octopus * Soft tofu * Rice cakes * A handful of bok choy (or bean sprouts) * Fresh red chili, sliced 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Heat the chili oil over medium heat. Crack in one egg and let the edges crisp slightly. 2. Add the shrimp heads, crab, baby octopus, garlic, and green onion. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. 3. Remove the egg and octopus so they don’t overcook. 4. Stir in the Shin Ramyun soup base and veggie packet, then pour in the water. Bring to a boil. 5. Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili. Enjoy immediately. 💡 Tip: Add a splash of soy sauce if the broth needs a little more seasoning.  #asmrfood #mukbang #ramenhacks #hangovercure #fyp

How I Review My Lectures without Rereading Everything. 📚 Every semester starts the same. ✨ I tell myself I'll go back and review every lecture after class... but the slides just keep piling up, and when I finally have time to study, I don't even know where to start. 😅 So I changed one small thing in my routine. Now I open Kilonotes first. 📖 I import my lecture slides, let AI Summary pull out the key ideas, and start with a quick recap instead of reading everything from the beginning. ✍️ From there, I turn those ideas into notes that actually make sense to me, then create a few flashcards to test myself before moving on. 📝🃏 It doesn't make studying effortless, but it makes getting started so much easier. And I've realized that's usually the hardest part. 🤍 #Kilonotes #backtoschool #takenotes #studytok #studywithme
